question: Where can I find a fast food restaurant that are within 60 kilometers and lie northeast of Holiday Inn & Suites Joliet Southwest, Joliet, IL?
sql: SELECT id, poi_name, addr_state, addr_city FROM pois AS p WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_DWithin( p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Holiday Inn & Suites Joliet Southwest%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Joliet%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IL%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 60000 ) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Holiday Inn & Suites Joliet Southwest%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Joliet%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IL%' LIMIT 1 ), p.geometry )) BETWEEN 22.5 AND 67.5;
